title: Training Questions and Answers: Renewal Share on the Final Water Overage Charge
content:
# Final-Overage Renewal Share — Utility Services Program, All-Inclusive Utility Package Water

**Rule.** A final-overage renewal share applies to the final water overage line of an All-Inclusive Utility Package account: **0.90** when the lease has at least 3 renewal rent changes on record, **0.95** when it has at least 1 but fewer than 3, and the **whole charge** otherwise. The share multiplies the line's charge, which is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Questions answered

**What is a renewal rent change?** A rent change recorded with the reason renewal on the Lease Term Agreement records of the lease.

**Two renewals on record?** 0.95.

**Three or more?** 0.90.

**None?** The whole charge.

*Worked case (hypothetical charge of $31.50):* 0.90 gives $28.35; 0.95 gives $29.925, which is $29.93 at the end.
